propositions: step-budget exhaustion raises LLMRunnerError which is an ancestor of UnretryableOutputError, so the except clause catching only UnretryableOutputError never matches
CompletionAgentStep.run does not route budget exhaustion to bounded recovery because it lacks a typed entry edge for the budget error subclass
bounded recovery mechanism provides the correct isolation and convergence behavior needed for step-budget exhaustion but remains unreachable without explicit exception type handling
a new LLMBudgetExhaustedError typed subclass must be introduced and raised from interpret_failure's budget branch to enable type-based routing
the except clause in CompletionAgentStep.run must be extended to catch the new LLMBudgetExhaustedError subclass and route it to _recover
budget diagnostics must be preserved on failure_diagnostic before recovery so counters survive even if recovery also fails
